t: Russia Will Call on OSCE to Respond to Reports About Torture Chambers in Ukraine - Envoy
d: Russia will raise the issue of torture chambers n Ukraine at a meeting of the OSCE Permanent Council on Thursday and will call on the organization’s relevant institutions to assess these events, Dmitry Polyanskiy said.

t: Kushner States Need to Involve Europe in Resolving Ukraine Conflict
d: MOSCOW, (Sputnik) - US special envoy Jared Kushner stated the importance of involving European countries in resolving the Ukraine conflict.

t: US Envoys Witkoff, Kushner Arrive at Kremlin
d: Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said on Thursday that he had held preliminary consultations with US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner before their meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

t: Iran, Oman Reached Understanding on Navigation in Strait of Hormuz – Ghalibaf
d: Iran and Oman have reached an understanding on navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said in an interview with Al Jazeera.

t: Russian Firepower Batters Ukrainian Airfields, Inflicting Heavy Losses — MoD
d: Ukraine lost over 345 soldiers in combat against Russia's Battlegroup over the past day, in addition to losses in manpower and equipment on other fronts, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Thursday.

t: Musk Says Would Be Honored to Hire Embattled Nvidia CEO
d: US tech entrepreneur Elon Musk said on Thursday that he would be glad to hire Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang amid speculation that the US chipmaker's board may oust Huang following an affair scandal.

t: EU Leaders Await Macron's Exit to Shut Down European Political Community - Reports
d: European leaders hope that the European Political Community (EPC) summit will not survive the departure of French President Emmanuel Macron from office in 2027, Politico reported on Thursday.

t: Ukraine Crisis Can Only End With Russia's Security Interests Considered - Jordanian Politician
d: "The Ukrainian crisis could conclude with the establishment of a comprehensive security system that accounts for the importance of Russia’s security," Jordanian politician Said Al-Masri told Sputnik.

t: Putin Thanks Trump for Facilitating Russia-Ukraine Contacts During Kremlin Meeting
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin said he was pleased to welcome US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to Moscow.

t: Trump Claims US Needs No Peace Deal With Iran
d: US President Donald Trump claimed on Thursday that the United States does not need a peace settlement with Iran.

t: Trump Threatens to Double Tariffs on Mexico Over Migrant Caravans
d: US President Donald Trump on Thursday threatened to double tariffs on Mexico if the latter fails to stop migrant caravans heading toward the United States.

t: Putin's Meeting With Witkoff, Kushner in Kremlin Lasted About 2.5 Hours
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin's talks with US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in the Kremlin have concluded, and they lasted approximately 2.5 hours, a Sputnik correspondent reported on Thursday.
